reason: A more directly addresses high-temperature, time-dependent deformation with a composition-matched monolithic baseline, long-duration creep testing, interface-stability boundaries, and a clear falsification criterion. Although its claim that interfaces suppress diffusion requires verification because interfaces can also provide fast-diffusion paths, B focuses partly on room-temperature indentation and does not vary lattice misfit independently, so its experiment cannot decisively attribute the effect to misfit stress fields.
